        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Define final transform and generate test output
def rot90_cw(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    return [[grid[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

def rot90_ccw(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    return [list(row) for row in reversed(list(zip(*grid)))]

def rot180(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

def transform_gcm_v2(grid):
    """Grid-cell-match expansion: 2x input sized with 4 rotated quadrants"""
    n = len(grid)
    output = []
    for i in range(2*n):
        if i < n:
            output.append(grid[i] + rot90_cw(grid)[i])
        else:
            output.append(rot90_ccw(grid)[i-n] + rot180(grid)[i-n])
    return output

# Test input

def test_rot90_cw(grid):
    """Rotate clockwise 90 degrees"""
    n = len(grid)
    # Clockwise: (i, j) -> (j, n-1-i)
    return [[grid[n-1-i][j] for i in range(n)] for j in range(n)]

def test_rot90_ccw(grid):
    """Rotate counter-clockwise 90 degrees"""
    n = len(grid)
    # Counter-clockwise: (i, j) -> (n-1-j, i) 
    return [[grid[j][n-1-i] for i in range(n)] for j in range(n)]
    
def test_rot180(grid):
    """Rotate 180 degrees"""
    n = len(grid)
    # 180: (i, j) -> (n-1-i, n-1-j)
    return [[grid[n-1-i][n-1-j] for i in range(n)] for j in range(n)]
